name: Duelist × Engage
original_name: デュエリスト×エンゲージ
source:
Shidou Yukito’s mornings are always busy. Waking up before the sun rises, battling against the cold air and temptations to go back to sleep, every second is too valuable to waste. 

A regular day, regular people, and Monaka’s regularly forgotten lunch box, Yukito is content with his peaceful normal life. That is, until his estranged father died.

Out of the blue, a woman who claims to be his father’s secretary informs him of a tremendous debt his father has left behind with his legacy and wants Yukito to succeed in his place or else Café Soleil, along with their house, will be subject to bankruptcy claims. A debt that can’t be cleared in any reasonable amount of time, let alone the deadline is in less than a year, Yukito’s only choice is to marry his fiancée from the Corangrane Kingdom in Europe, a descendant from the noble Soleil Family. And that fiancée is coming to meet him tomorrow.

And as if that wasn’t enough, the first words coming out of her mouth was:

“So you are my fiancé. En guarde!”

Will Yukito be alright? The fiery duels between unshakable wills over marriage, the battle royale has begun!

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/02/22/duelist-engage-first-impression/]Warum's Blog[/url]]
translation:
志藤征斗的早晨总是十分忙碌。太阳升起前便得起床，与寒冷的空气和回去睡觉的诱惑作斗争，每一秒都珍贵得不能浪费。

平常的日子，平常的人们，还有总是忘带便当的萌菜香；征斗满足于这样宁静而普通的生活。直到与他疏远的父亲去世。

一名自称是父亲秘书的女子突然出现，告诉他父亲留下了一笔巨额债务，要他继承并承担；否则，索莱伊咖啡馆连同他们的房子都将面临破产清算。债务根本不可能在合理时间内还清，更别说期限不足一年。征斗唯一的选择，是迎娶来自欧洲科兰格兰王国的未婚妻；她是贵族索莱伊家族的后裔。那位未婚妻明天就会来见他。

仿佛这样还不够，她开口说的第一句话竟是：

“那么，你就是我的未婚夫了。接招吧！”

征斗没事吗？围绕婚姻、两股不屈意志之间的炽烈决斗，混战已经开幕！

[摘自[url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/02/22/duelist-engage-first-impression/]Warum's Blog[/url]]
